taxonomy_classification.classification_basis: Current-taxonomy review against VIGIL Failure Taxonomy 0.6.5 retains the occurrence as unclassified. VIGIL-FC-000002 Capability-Authority Conflation and VIGIL-FC-000003 Target and Scope Authority Transposition were tested because the reporting describes stolen credentials and illicit use, but the preserved evidence does not establish the provider's actor/action/scope permission logic or show that a valid authority grant was affirmatively transposed rather than authentication being defeated by credential theft. VIGIL-FC-000041 Required Governance Route Bypass and VIGIL-FC-000038 Required Control Non-Activation were also considered because reporting uses guardrail-bypass language, but the record does not establish the defined required route or trigger condition needed to assert either mechanism. The cyber-abuse occurrence therefore remains unclassified rather than inferring an internal governance mechanism from hostile access.
